Menu

class Menu(surface, settings, state)[source]

Bases: object

Manage all menus and feedback screens of the game.

Reads from the GameState which screen to show (state.menu) and the level counters (state.level_stats); it does not change the state.

With feet click on (state.feet_click), update receives the feet position: the buttons are also triggered by the feet and the feet dot is drawn on top of everything. selected_by_feet tells whether the last action came from the feet.

Parameters:
surfacepygame.Surface

Game screen.

settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

stateGameState

Match state.

Attributes:
surfacepygame.Surface

Game screen.

settingsGameSettings

Game configuration.

stateGameState

Match state.

uiUI

Drawing helpers (buttons, texts, feet dot).

backgroundBackground

Road background with the menu image.

click_soundpygame.mixer.Sound

Menu click sound.

feet_postuple | None

Feet position in the current frame (None: feet selection off or player not detected).

selected_by_feetbool

True if the action returned by the last update came from the feet.

Notes

All texts are translated with gettext _() (i18n).

Methods

draw

Draw the basic menu background.

draw_feedback

Draw the feedback screen with the level statistics.

Draw the player's first name centered under the trophy.

Update the current menu and return the chosen action.
draw()[source]

Draw the basic menu background.

draw_feedback()[source]

Draw the feedback screen with the level statistics.

One (label, value) row every 30 px from y=100, aligned with the content area of the background image.

draw_player_name()[source]

Draw the player’s first name centered under the trophy.

The trophy of the feedback images is centered at x=200 and ends near y=400 (800x600 base), so the name is centered at (200, 430) of the content area. Nothing is drawn without a name.

update(feet_pos=None)[source]

Update the current menu and return the chosen action.

Actions: “game” (play/continue), “prev”, “rest”, “next” (pause menu), “play” (feedback screen: starts the level already defined) and “exit”. selected_by_feet tells whether the action came from the feet.

Parameters:
feet_postuple | None, optional

Feet (x, y) position on screen, when feet click is on (state.feet_click). None: mouse/keyboard only.

Returns:
str | None

The chosen action, or None.
